verdict.rationale: The GeForce RTX 5090 is a consumer GPU, a hardware product with no hosted web service API. A downloadable OpenAPI-style spec is therefore a category error for this product type. The CUDA Tile IR specification is a kernel programming IR, not a machine-readable API spec, so it does not make the axis applicable, and the OpenAPI probe paths on the developer portal all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
